items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that cleans without stripping skin that already looks dry and flaky.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream to support the look of a comfortable, well-moisturized skin barrier.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 with iron oxides for daily sun protection that blends well on deeper skin tones.

response.routine_note: I've left out the glycolic toner and the vitamin C serum because strong exfoliating acids and high-strength actives are usually too harsh while on isotretinoin, so please ask your prescriber or dermatologist before adding any active. Use the cleanser morning and night, the cream after cleansing, and the SPF last every morning.
